name: Flux Distributor
desc: Increases the ship's flux dissipation by %s/%s/%s/%s, depending on hull size.
sModDesc: Increases flux dissipation by a further %s/%s/%s/%s.

name: XIV-A
desc: This ship is a survivor of the original 14th Domain Battlegroup which founded the Hegemony. It is a prime specimen of the Domain Navy's "decisive battle" doctrine, particularly exhibited by a series of radical structural modifications (performed with pre-Collapse industrial methods) which allow the mounting of heavier armor plating by a flat increase of %s standard units, with only a %s reduction in speed and maneuverability. These hulls are members of Taskforce Safeguard, retrofit for their eternal vigil. Exceptionally well-tuned energy systems increase flux throughput and capacity by %s over standard examples of this hull. Extreme modifications and retrofits have raised this hull's Deployment Points by %s/%s/%s/%s.

name: Sub-System Modernization
desc:
In reaction to advancements in technology, this vessel's aging systems have been swapped out in a modernization initiative as part of a desperate attempt to maintain the hull's relevancy.

Reduces Minimum Crew requirements by %s.

name: Increased Maintenance
desc: Increases the monthly maintenance supply cost by %s.
short: Increases maintenance cost, as a result of sub-system modernizations.

name: Improved Ablative Armor
desc:
An ancient design intended to stop micro-meteorites through sheer volume of material in place, before the advent of "spaced" armor. This ship has had it's armor improved by the military engineers of the 14th battlegroup, in an attempt to bring it back into viability.

Reduces the effective armor strength for the damage reduction calculation to %s of its actual value. However, ships of this design tend to carry extremely heavy armor.

name: Heavy Composite Integration
desc: Reduces the ordnance point cost of large ballistic and missile weapons by %s.
short: Reduces ordnance point cost of large ballistic and missile weapons.

name: Improved Ablative Armor
desc:
An ancient design intended to stop micro-meteorites through sheer volume of material in place, before the advent of "spaced" armor. This ship has had it's armor improved by the top engineers of the domain navy, resulting in it being far more effective.

Reduces the effective armor strength for the damage reduction calculation to %s of its actual value. However, ships of this design tend to carry extremely heavy armor.

name: Ancient Forge
desc: An ancient, rudimentary nanoforge design, this forge is severely limted compared to those seen within the modern persean sector. Time to launch replacement fighters is increased by %s.

name: Design Compromises
desc:
The ship's performance suffers from competing design priorities, with multiple bleeding-edge projects integrated too late in the design cycle.

The ship's flux dissipation and capacity, even the nominal base values, are reduced by %s.

The range of ballistic weapons is reduced by %s, the rate of fire of missile weapons is reduced by %s, and the flux generation of energy weapons is increased by %s.

The ordnance point cost to mount large missile weapons is increased by %s.

Fortunately, the changes made do also result in an ordnance point cost reduction of %s for large energy weapons.
short: Reduces missile and ballistic weapon range, and flux dissipation / capacity.

name: Enraged Systems
desc: At the heart of this infernal vessel's unsettlingly advanced technological entrails lie a series of anomalous subsystems, driving its capability for rampant destruction. A majority of these systems operate by capturing energy resulting from overloading starship reactors.

name: Hardened Armor
desc: An ancient design standard intended to increase the effectivness and survivability of shieldless hulls, developed before the advent of such technology that would replace it.

name: Tellasian League Refit
short: Reduces missile and ballistic weapon range, and flux dissipation / capacity.

name: Targeting Supercomputer
desc: An extremely advanced targeting array is integrated into this vessel.

name: Invicta
desc: Integrated into the control systems of this colossal vessel, the AI core, Invicta, cannot be removed by any conventional means, short of destroying the vessel.

name: Communications Array
desc: A state-of-the-art hyperwave array is used by this ship to broadcast music at FTL.
